scope: Hypothetical public hospital with collective accommodation, public seating and counters, a garage, an exterior crossing and a marked public circulation network. The labels are manual scenario judgements for the selected obligations, without independent review.
plan_truth: Firm smooth paths have a fixed bollard blocking wheelchair passage; the significant level change has no ramp. One sidewalk is 1.65 m; the curb cut has slopes 4%, 4%, 6%. One of twenty garage stalls is adapted. The bollard blocks the only accessible approach. One of ten counters and one of twenty seats is adapted. Zero of ten patient-room/toilet equipment groups are adapted. No compliant lift. Public circulation spans are 2.20 m and 1.80 m wide with longitudinal slopes at 5% and 8%. Turning landing is 0.8 m². Handrails are on one side. Main entrance 1.10 m wide with 10% lateral slope. Two entries, with an appropriate fixed telephone at both.

clauses.meaning: Outdoor circulation surface must be firm, smooth and unobstructed for wheels and canes.
Each substantial change in level needs an inclined path.
Sidewalk width must be within the inclusive 1.50 m to 2.00 m range.
clauses.gap: Exterior pedestrian inventory and clear widths

clauses.meaning: The perpendicular curb-cut incline and both side transitions must each be below 5%.
At least one in twenty stalls in public car parks or open-to-public garages must be reserved.
clauses.gap: Parking bay inventory and reserved designation

clauses.meaning: The listed building classes must be adapted and have a usable accessible approach route.
When customers use counters, shelves or writing surfaces, one in ten of the relevant equipment must be adapted.
One in twenty seats in public rooms must be adapted.
In the specified public buildings, adapt one in ten of the equipment in rooms and sanitary facilities.
Public circulation spaces must be served by lifts that conform to the referenced standards.
clauses.gap: Lift conformance evidence against referenced standard

clauses.meaning: Public circulation passages must be at least 2 m wide and no steeper than 12%; both conditions apply.
Each change of direction needs a resting landing of at least 1 m².
The relevant passages require handrails on both sides.
The principal entrance must be at least 1 m wide with lateral slope no more than 20%.
clauses.gap: Principal entrance identification and lateral slope

clauses.meaning: Provide a fixed telephone for people with visual or hearing impairments at the rate of one per entrance.
clauses.gap: Telephone inventory, accessible type and entrance association
